pages.title: Reality Lattice Casing
pages.text: A casing that contains computronium and a Bekenstein crystal to keep track of every bit of information inside it. The Bekenstein bound limits how much information a region can hold; this casing sits right at it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Machines that rewrite reality need a shell that keeps the books. I combined computronium with a Bekenstein crystal over cosmogenic casing, so the casing knows exactly how much information is in it at all times.

Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Superintelligence.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Anomaly Resolution Engine, Axiom Distiller, Cantor Diagonalizer, Convergence Engine, Reality Compiler, Transfinite Casing.
